My Approach

Birth is not a medical event to be managed — it is a profound human experience to be witnessed with care.

Every family I support receives my undivided presence. I don't bring a script or a checklist — I bring years of training, deep listening, and a genuine belief that you already hold the strength you need. My role is simply to help you find it.

I work through Doulas of Baltimore, which means you have the confidence of a vetted, credentialed professional with the warmth of a personal relationship.

What I Offer

Support for every stage

❧

Birth Support

Continuous labor and birth support from early labor through delivery. Physical comfort measures, emotional guidance, and advocacy for your birth preferences — for you and your partner. I attend all hospitals, all birth centers, and home births where a licensed midwife is present.

  • Two prenatal visits
  • On-call support from 37 weeks
  • Continuous labor and birth attendance
  • Postpartum follow-up visit
  • Fees range from $1,500–$2,500 (payment plans available)
◈

Childbirth Education

Private, personalized birth preparation sessions for you and your support person. We cover what matters to your specific situation — no generic classroom approach.

  • Labor stages and comfort techniques
  • Birth setting and team communication
  • Newborn basics
  • Custom to your birth preferences
✦

Virtual Support

Remote and virtual doula support for families outside my in-person service area or those who prefer flexible, distance-based care. Available throughout your pregnancy, labor, and postpartum period.

  • Prenatal preparation sessions via video call
  • Virtual labor support and guidance
  • Postpartum check-ins
  • Flexible scheduling to fit your needs

All services are booked through Doulas of Baltimore.

About Mikaela

A familiar face for an unforgettable day.

I'm Mikaela Iwaskiw, a DONA-certified birth doula based in Gwynn Oak, Maryland. Over the past five years I've had the privilege of supporting over 20 families through labor, birth, and the early days of parenthood.

I believe every birthing person deserves continuous, compassionate support and a knowledgeable advocate in their corner. Whether you're planning a hospital birth, a birth center experience, or a home birth with a midwife, I'm here for you.

I hold the CD(DONA) credential through DONA International, completed my training in January 2023, and am certified in First Aid and CPR. I'm happy to discuss payment plans to make sure support is accessible to you.

Credential: CD(DONA) — DONA International Agency: Doulas of Baltimore Serving: Gwynn Oak, MD & within 40 miles
